actions.desc: The Moonlit King causes the shadows of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him to animate and attack their owners. Each target must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 49 (14d6) necrotic damage, and its Strength score is reduced by 1d4. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, and its Strength score isn't reduced. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its Strength to 0.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Crystal Staff

actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius until the end of its next turn. If the target is a creature in a form other than its true form, it takes an extra 11 (2d10) radiant damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or revert to its true form.

actions.desc: The Moonlit King teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. The origin and destination spaces must contain moonlight.

actions.desc: When a creature the Moonlit King can see within 30 feet of him attacks him, he takes on the quality of his manifest delusions, temporarily becoming ghostly. The attack roll has disadvantage, and if it hits, the Moonlit King takes only half the damage from the attack.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Теневой Слип»; тип: reaction. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).

actions.desc: The Moonlit King changes the brightness of each area of moonlight he can see within 120 feet of him from dim light to bright light or vice versa.

actions.desc:
The Moonlit King casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save DC 19):

- **At Will:** continual flame, invisibility (self only), moonbeam, zone of truth
- **3/Day Each:** dispel evil and good, dispel magic, major image
- **1/Day Each:** heal, project image
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Спеллкастинг»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).

actions.desc: Each creature within 30 feet of the Moonlit King must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or suffer short-term madness. The Moonlit King can use this legendary action only when he is in moonlight.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Спреад Маднесс»; тип: legendary_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Spread Madness

actions.desc: The Moonlit King magically calls a lunar devil to aid him. The devil arrives in 1d4 rounds, acting as ally of the Moonlit King and obeying his spoken commands. The devil remains for 1 hour, until the Moonlit King dies, or until the King dismisses it as a bonus action.

ru.description: Средняя фея, мировоззрение: нейтрально-доброе. Класс доспеха: 17 (природный доспех). Хиты: 204 (24к8 + 96). Скорость: ходьба 30 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 16, ЛОВ 20, ТЕЛ 18, ИНТ 20, МУД 18, ХАР 20. Сопротивление урону: кислотой, дробящего, колющего. Иммунитет к урону: холодом, огнём, ядом. Иммунитет к состояниям: очарование, испуг, отравление. Чувства: тёмное зрение 120 фт., слепое зрение 30 фт., пассивное Восприятие 20. Показатель опасности: 17.
